title: Experts disagree on new paqad-ai report speed
context:
Chief architect: Not a real disagreement: all three restate #756 'It only reads. It never writes into .paqad/ and never sends anything anywhere' plus its Done when. The security claim is the one that is directly testable (tree byte-identical before and after), so it carries the set. Pick this option to accept all three.

Target: new paqad-ai report speed
- security-auditor: the command only reads: it writes nothing under .paqad/, opens no network connection and spawns no process; a test asserts the .paqad tree is byte-identical before and after a run
- product-owner: done from the Developer / Operator's seat: one command on their own project prints lane, busy, development, ceremony, orchestrator and owner-wait per change, and a project with no transcripts prints 'no transcript' rows and exits 0
- product-owner: the report only reads and only prints numbers, categories and change titles; it never prints prompt or tool text, never writes into .paqad/ and never sends anything anywhere
